subject: Post-call: Cyber Assurance & IR Evidence Kickoff — SummitCare
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@summitcare.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cyber Assurance & IR Evidence Kickoff — SummitCare

Hi Hannah / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of the items we agreed to follow up on from the discovery:

- SOC 2 status & expected completion date (type II scope)
- HIPAA data flow confirmation and any BAAs on file
- Incident response (IR) / breach notification timelines you require (notification SLA)
- BCP/DR evidence (BCP summary + latest tabletop/exercise notes)
- Completion of the vendor security questionnaire you shared in the call

Next steps from our side: I attached a short cyber assurance one-pager that maps Redwood controls to common evidence items. Ben and I will prepare a short IR runbook sample and a list of artifacts you can pull from our VDR. Could you: (1) confirm the SOC 2 type you need for procurement, (2) send the preferred secure link for uploading docs if you have one (or we can provide a VDR link), and (3) confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire?

Proposed timeline: if we can get the questionnaire back and SOC 2 scope confirmed by next Wednesday (8/27), we should be able to stage an evidence bundle in the VDR by Friday (8/29). Let us know if that aligns with your procurement windows.

Attachments: redwood-cyber-assurance-onepager.pdf

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
redwoodinference.com

From: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@summitcare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cyber Assurance & IR Evidence Kickoff — SummitCare

Neha —

Appreciate the recap and the one-pager. Quick answers from my side:

- SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II for production vendor onboarding. You mentioned you have an attestation in progress — can you share the expected audit completion window?
- HIPAA: SummitCare needs BAA-confirmation for any PHI processing. We will need the signed BAA before production.
- IR/Breach notification: Our procurement policy requires initial notice to our InfoSec team within 24 hours of detection and a substantive update within 72 hours. Final root-cause + remediation report within 30 days.
- BCP/DR evidence: a 1–2 page BCP summary plus the latest tabletop exercise notes or after-action review is sufficient for initial review.

I've attached the vendor security questionnaire (filled with a few placeholders we expect you to complete) and created a secure folder for uploads: https://drive.summitcare.com/secure/redwood-uploads (credentials: shared separately via our SFTP).

We'll own the questionnaire on our side — Raj will be the primary reviewer for technical evidence. Please upload the evidence bundle to the secure folder and ping me when ready.

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire-summitcare.xlsx

Thanks,
Hannah Cole
Director, InfoSec | SummitCare
Hannah.cole@summitcare.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@summitcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitcare.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cyber Assurance & IR Evidence Kickoff — SummitCare

Hannah —

Perfect, thanks for the clarity and the upload link. A few quick notes from our side:

- SOC 2 timeline: We're mid-audit with an expected Type II report Q4 (target completion week of 11/16). We can prepare interim evidence (control reports, SOC readiness attestations, auditor engagement letter) for your review before the formal report is issued.
- BAA: We have a standard BAA template; legal can send a draft for signature once procurement confirms the template is acceptable.
- IR notification SLA: 24/72/30 window is noted and we can commit to that in contractual terms; I'll flag legal to ensure the language is present in the BAA/contract.
- BCP/DR evidence: We'll stage a preliminary bundle in your secure folder by 8/29 as discussed.

Action items we will complete by 8/29:
1) Upload preliminary IR evidence bundle to your secure folder (includes incident register excerpt, notification flow diagram, last tabletop after-action notes) — will be zipped as summitcare-vdr-IR-evidence.zip
2) Complete the vendor questionnaire fields and upload the completed xlsx
3) Share a redwood IR runbook sample and 1–2 page BCP summary (attached as a draft runbook PDF)

Ben / Lauren — looping you both so Lauren can coordinate the artifacts and Ben can stay aligned on procurement timing.

Neha
